context: Kenji and Daichi help Hiroshi-elder set up his vegetable garden.
purpose: Two friends helping elder with seasonal yard work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: This soil is really good, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, observational. Soft Kansai lilt. Hands running through earth. Settling into the moment like a man who knows soil. No rush.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Bright agreement without lifting off the ground. Kansai warmth — the kind that comes from knowing seasons. Relaxed exhale of certainty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 何の野菜、植えるんかな。
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Kansai inflection softens the question. Leaning in slightly — not interrogating, inviting. The voice of someone comfortable not knowing.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: トマト、キュウリ、たくさん。
lines.en: Tomatoes, cucumbers — going to be plenty of them.
lines.style: Affectionate catalogue. Kansai warmth. Each vegetable named like a small promise. Slight smile underneath the words. Relaxed, generous tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to the harvest.
lines.style: Quiet anticipation. Kansai gentleness. Gaze forward but grounded. The voice of someone who's already tasting it. Warm finality without being final.
